def ma_crossover(
    prices: pd.DataFrame, mask: pd.DataFrame, fast: int = 50, slow: int = 200
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Own a stock while its 50-day average is above its 200-day average, equally weighted
    among the stocks that qualify; the rest of the money stays in cash. A common textbook
    trend rule; its values are not tuned here."""
    fast_avg = prices.rolling(fast, min_periods=fast).mean()
    slow_avg = prices.rolling(slow, min_periods=slow).mean()
    on = (fast_avg > slow_avg) & mask
    count = mask.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan)
    return on.astype(float).div(count, axis=0).fillna(0.0)

def weights(excess: pd.Series, kind: str) -> pd.Series:
    """Exposure to the market for each day, decided at the first close of each month."""
    risk = realised(excess)
    months = pd.Series(excess.index.to_period("M"), index=excess.index)
    month_start = months.ne(months.shift(1))
    measure = risk["var"] if kind == "variance" else risk["vol"]
    # The scale: average past risk up to that day, so average exposure is near 1.
    scale = measure.expanding(min_periods=WINDOW * 12).mean()
    raw = (scale / measure).clip(upper=MAX_LEVERAGE)
    decided = raw.where(month_start).ffill()
    return decided
